cells.plg-java: Explicit types, braces, classes as the unit of design.
cells.plg-go: Short decls, packages, multiple return values, no classes.
cells.plg-python: Indentation, duck typing with optional annotations.
cells.plg-ruby: Everything is an object; end closes blocks; implicit return.

code.plg-python:
def add(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a + b

cells.plg-java: Static, nominal types; generics; increasingly records/sealed types.
cells.plg-go: Static structural interfaces; generics since 1.18; methods stay concrete-first.
cells.plg-python: Dynamic runtime + gradual static checking (pyright/mypy); Pydantic at boundaries.
cells.plg-ruby: Dynamic duck typing; optional Sorbet/RBS for gradual static checking.

cells.plg-java: Platform threads, virtual threads, ExecutorService, CompletableFuture, JMM.
cells.plg-go: Goroutines + channels + context; errgroup for bounded fan-out.
cells.plg-python: asyncio event loop; threads for blocking; GIL limits CPU threads.
cells.plg-ruby: Threads (GVL limits CPU parallelism); Fibers/Async for IO; Ractors for isolation.

code.plg-go:
g, ctx := errgroup.WithContext(ctx)
g.Go(func() error { return work(ctx) })
g.Wait()
code.plg-python:
async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as tg:
    tg.create_task(work())

cells.plg-go: Explicit error returns; wrap with fmt.Errorf / %w; panic for true bugs.
cells.plg-python: Exceptions everywhere; EAFP style; context managers for cleanup.
cells.plg-ruby: raise / rescue / ensure; custom StandardError subclasses for domain failures.

cells.plg-go: go.mod / go.sum; module proxy; minimal dependency culture.
cells.plg-ruby: RubyGems + Bundler; Gemfile / Gemfile.lock for apps.

rows.aspect: Default path to HTTP APIs / apps

cells.plg-java: Spring Boot MVC / WebFlux; Jakarta EE in enterprises.
cells.plg-go: net/http stdlib; chi/echo/fiber when needed — frameworks stay thin.
cells.plg-python: FastAPI for APIs; Django for batteries-included apps.
cells.plg-ruby: Rails (full-stack) or Sinatra (micro); Rack under the hood.

cells.plg-java: JUnit 5, AssertJ, Testcontainers, Mockito (sparingly at senior level).
cells.plg-go: testing package, table-driven tests, httptest, integration over heavy mocks.
cells.plg-python: pytest, httpx AsyncClient, factories; hypothesis for properties.
cells.plg-ruby: Minitest (stdlib) or RSpec; prefer behavior at public boundaries.

cells.plg-java: Warm JIT, GC tuning, excellent throughput after warmup; heavier memory.
cells.plg-go: Fast startup, small binaries, predictable latency; GC is simpler.
cells.plg-python: Great for I/O and glue; CPU-bound needs native/async offload; uv/Pydantic help DX.
cells.plg-ruby: Developer velocity first; YJIT helps latency; watch allocations and IO.

cells.plg-java: Large enterprise domains, strong typing, long-lived JVM services.
cells.plg-go: Cloud services, CLIs, networking, infra — concurrency with simplicity.
cells.plg-python: APIs, data/AI, scripting, glue between systems.
cells.plg-ruby: Expressive apps and DSLs; rapid product iteration; scripting with readable OO.
